NOTE: Trigon Healthcare Inc said its net income per share after demutualization and IPO reflects net income and net income per share for the period after February 5, 1997, the effective date of the Demutualization and Initial Public Offering.

Pro forma information gives effect to the Demutualization and IPO as if they had occurred on January 1, 1996, consistent with the company's pro forma presentation in its Form S-1 filed on January 29, 1997, in connection with its IPO, adjustment of the effective income tax rate for 1996 to the 35 percent statutory federal rate in conformity with the company's pro forma presentation in its Form S-1 filing, the actual effective income tax rate of 34.3 percent for 1997.
The pro forma income tax benefit for the six months ended June 30, 1997 represents the income tax benefit associated with the pro forma interest expense adjustment.

The pro forma information assumes interest expense at 5.675 percent per annum for the six months ended June 30, 1997, and 5.856 percent and 5.765 percent per annum for the three months and six months ended June 30, 1996, respectively, on borrowings used to fund a portion of the Commonwealth Payment.
